title: audits converges — the full checkpoint trail
description: The imperative pipeline records eight distinct checkpoint ids, all approved; a graph run records end-of-pipeline three times as [approved, rejected, approved]. Declare the remaining ids and let the trail match.

successCriteria.description: The topology declares the checkpoint ids the imperative pipeline records, subject to whatever sprint 1's ADR permits. Any id that remains undeclarable is named with the ADR reason.
A real conformance run records the same SET of checkpoint ids from both engines — verified by running the harness, not by reading the pin.
The middle 'rejected' record is gone, because sprint 2's durable approval lets commit through rather than because a refusal was reclassified as an approval.
'audits' no longer appears in the divergence set, and the divergence-set pin still fails in BOTH directions.
Golden cases whose artifacts move are re-captured in this sprint, diff hunks read.
Full suite, typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, and the golden gate passing at or above its replay floor.

nonGoals: Closing history, contracts or pipelineResult — later sprints.
Reclassifying a refusal to make the trail match.
stopConditions: Sprint 1's ADR left some ids undeclarable — declare what is legal, record the rest with the ADR reason, and amend the spec's audits goal rather than forcing it.
definitionOfDone: All required criteria met, the full suite plus typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, the golden gate passing, and every documentation claim added backed by a test that fails when the claim stops being true.
generatorNotes: The per-field record in src/orchestrator/workflow/conformance.engines.test.ts states the exact shape of this divergence — read it first. Only two ids are declared today (src/pge/topology/coding.graph.ts:483 post-plan, :909 end-of-pipeline). post-sprint-contract may be declarable outside the fan-out even if sprint 1 forbade the five inside it. Remember post-plan is declared but never EVALUATED on the golden fixture, because a settled plan takes e-plan-ok and never e-plan-clarify. Run the suite as `npx vitest run --exclude '**/.claude/worktrees/**' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'` — a bare run picks up nested worktrees. Verify on a CLEAN checkout, not just the working tree: this repo has twice been green locally and red in CI because uncommitted state was carrying the result.
evaluatorNotes: Run the conformance harness yourself and compare the id sets — do not read the pin. Then check the outcomes list: a trail that matches only because a rejection became an approval is a false convergence, and the sprint fails. Verify the pin still bites both ways. Run the suite as `npx vitest run --exclude '**/.claude/worktrees/**' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'` — a bare run picks up nested worktrees. Verify on a CLEAN checkout, not just the working tree: this repo has twice been green locally and red in CI because uncommitted state was carrying the result.
